basic_details.job_title: District AYUSH Society Dhanbad District Program Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District AYUSH Society Dhanbad, Jharkhand, has invited applications for the post of District Program Manager under Advt No. 448/Ayush Dhanbad. Applications are accepted online until 28 November 2026.

age_limit.age_details: Minimum- 21 years Maximum- 60 years (as on 1 August 2023)

qualification.education_qualification: Graduation in any discipline including AYUSH and MBA in Healthcare Management/Masters in health/hospital administration/Post Graduation diploma in Hospital & healthcare management (Two years).
qualification.details: Qualification: Graduation degree in any discipline including AYUSH; MBA in Healthcare Management/Masters in health/hospital administration/Post Graduation diploma in Hospital & healthcare management (Two years) Experience: Minimum 1 year working experience in Public health program. Age limit: Minimum- 21 years Maximum- 60 years (as on 1 August 2023) | Other conditions: | Maximum 18 days leave during a calendar year | Desirable: | Experience of working in Health sector including AYUSH MS Word, MS Power Point and MS Excel knowledge

exam_pattern.details: Written exam may be conducted if number of applications increases considerably

how_to_apply: Visit the JAP-IT website at https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in/.
Make the payment of Rs. 1,000/- on the portal.
important_instructions: Caste and Domicile certificates should not be older than 6 months before the last date of application

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation degree in any discipline including AYUSH; MBA in Healthcare Management/Masters in health/hospital administration/Post Graduation diploma in Hospital & healthcare management (Two years) Experience: Minimum 1 year working experience in Public health program. Age limit: Minimum- 21 years Maximum- 60 years (as on 1 August 2023) Other conditions: Maximum 18 days leave during a calendar year Desirable: Experience of working in Health sector including AYUSH MS Word, MS Power Point and MS Excel knowledge

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual employment for 1 year from date of appointment Contract may be extended or terminated based on performance Annual enhancement of 03% based on satisfactory performance

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for District AYUSH Society Dhanbad Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Visit the JAP-IT website at https://recruitment.jharkhand.gov.in/. Fill the online application form. Upload required documents. Make the payment of Rs. 1,000/- on the portal. Apply on or before 28 November 2026.
